title: Management Trainee
description:
This job is provided by apna.co Contact customers through calls and field visits to ensure timely payments.
   

  

 Understand customer concerns and provide appropriate solutions.
   

  

 Maintain accurate collection records and update daily collection activities.
   

  

 Achieve assigned monthly collection and recovery targets.
   

  

 Coordinate with internal teams for resolving customer/account\-related issues.
   

  

 Follow company Manage and follow up on assigned customer accounts for timely collections.
   

  

 Policies, collection processes, and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Develop strong customer relationships while maintaining professional communication
